title: Why You See Colours That Aren't Really There
hook: Your brain can invent colours from thin air.

narration.text: Your brain can invent colours from thin air.
This happens when your eyes get tired of seeing certain colours.
Look at this pattern now. Stare at the dot in the middle.
When you look away, your brain creates the opposite colour.
It is like a visual rebound effect.
This trick of the mind makes you see colours that are not truly there.
Did this work for you? Try it and tell me if you saw it, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more brain tricks.

description: Have you ever seen colours that were not really there? This short video explains why your brain sometimes creates visual afterimages, making you perceive colours that do not exist in the real world. It is a fascinating trick of human perception you can test yourself.
topic: Why you sometimes see colours that are not really there, known as optical illusions. You can test this right now with some patterns.
